Rows.Body: Map<String,Object> result=new Map<String,Object>(); String stage='setup'; String seedToken=''; try {SObject a=new Account(Name='Equality capture'); SObject b=a.clone(true,true,true,true);Set<SObject> keys=new Set<SObject>{b}; Map<SObject,String> keyed=new Map<SObject,String>{b=>'present'};stage='before'; result.put('before',new Map<String,Object>{'aMap'=>a.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(),'bMap'=>b.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(),'aJSON'=>JSON.serialize(a),'bJSON'=>JSON.serialize(b)});stage='mutation';a.put('Description',null);result.put('effect',new Map<String,Object>{'completed'=>true,'observed'=>a.get('Description')});stage='equality'; result.put('equality',new Map<String,Object>{'operator'=>a==b,'equals'=>a.equals(b),'aHash'=>a.hashCode(),'bHash'=>b.hashCode(),'setContains'=>keys.contains(a),'mapLookup'=>keyed.get(a)});stage='after'; result.put('after',new Map<String,Object>{'aMap'=>a.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(),'bMap'=>b.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(),'aJSON'=>JSON.serialize(a),'bJSON'=>JSON.serialize(b)}); result.put('core',new Map<String,Object>{'complete'=>true});}catch(Exception e){result.put('core',new Map<String,Object>{'fixtureError'=>true,'stage'=>stage,'type'=>e.getTypeName(),'message'=>e.getMessage()});}for(String snap:new List<String>{'before','after'}){if(result.containsKey(snap)){Map<String,Object> values=(Map<String,Object>)result.remove(snap); for(String k:values.keySet()) result.put(snap+k,values.get(k));}}

Rows.Body: Map<String,Object> result=new Map<String,Object>(); String stage='setup'; String seedToken=''; try {LyricTile__c seed=new LyricTile__c(Name='Equality seed'); insert seed; SObject a=[SELECT Id,Name,VerseSwitch__c,TempoZero__c,BlankCaption__c FROM LyricTile__c WHERE Id=:seed.Id]; SObject b=a.clone(true,true,true,true);seedToken=String.valueOf(seed.Id);Set<SObject> keys=new Set<SObject>{b}; Map<SObject,String> keyed=new Map<SObject,String>{b=>'present'};stage='before'; result.put('before',new Map<String,Object>{'aMap'=>a.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(),'bMap'=>b.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(),'aJSON'=>JSON.serialize(a),'bJSON'=>JSON.serialize(b)});stage='mutation';a.put('VerseSwitch__c',a.get('VerseSwitch__c'));result.put('effect',new Map<String,Object>{'completed'=>true,'observed'=>a.get('VerseSwitch__c')});stage='equality'; result.put('equality',new Map<String,Object>{'operator'=>a==b,'equals'=>a.equals(b),'aHash'=>a.hashCode(),'bHash'=>b.hashCode(),'setContains'=>keys.contains(a),'mapLookup'=>keyed.get(a)});stage='after'; result.put('after',new Map<String,Object>{'aMap'=>a.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(),'bMap'=>b.getPopulatedFieldsAsMap(),'aJSON'=>JSON.serialize(a),'bJSON'=>JSON.serialize(b)}); result.put('core',new Map<String,Object>{'complete'=>true});}catch(Exception e){result.put('core',new Map<String,Object>{'fixtureError'=>true,'stage'=>stage,'type'=>e.getTypeName(),'message'=>e.getMessage()});}for(String snap:new List<String>{'before','after'}){if(result.containsKey(snap)){Map<String,Object> values=(Map<String,Object>)result.remove(snap); for(String k:values.keySet()) result.put(snap+k,values.get(k));}}if(seedToken!=''){String safeText=JSON.serialize(result).replace(seedToken,'<seed-id>'); result=(Map<String,Object>)JSON.deserializeUntyped(safeText);}
